scope: Audit current mapped stress fields, supplied-pad cones and material support.

diagnostic_definitions.cone_force_allowance: 64*FP64_epsilon*sum(norm(original source forces)); raw violations are also retained
diagnostic_definitions.cross_gap_force_fraction: force norm on samples with x opposite to the witnessed source on the declared narrow-gap U arms
diagnostic_definitions.control_tensor_error: exact affine-corner volume-integrated Frobenius L2 relative to fixed continuous-traction reference
diagnostic_definitions.egg_tensor_error: independent FEM volume-quadrature Frobenius L2; source-prior is a model, not truth
